ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Farm And Home Management Educators, but it will take over more course-material work. AI can draft lessons, organize references, and create data charts quickly, shifting educators from making slides toward field visits and local solutions. ai_s5_persona.建议: Study agriculture or education and participate in community practice and rural field research during college. The role suits people who genuinely want to work in primary communities and engage with residents. Credentials and field experience both matter.
Use digital teaching tools and build a strong library of cases. Move toward project leadership by becoming an extension specialist who can run programs and produce results, not only deliver classes.

Agricultural or education experience supports a transition. Start as a Training Specialist or Extension Worker. In interviews, emphasize field visits, teaching experience, and practical problems solved; these examples often matter more than degrees.

Retention depends on stable projects, advancement paths, and fieldwork allowances. Educators who create online courses and reusable cases should be developed as core staff instead of valued only by teaching hours.

Project-based operations are becoming standard. Educators who produce outcomes and reusable cases gain value.

body: Farm And Home Management Educators teach farmers, families, and communities about agricultural production, household finance, nutrition, health, and daily management. Classroom instruction and field guidance help participants improve production and family life.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate a standard course deck in three minutes, but deciding what to plant in a field this year still requires examining the soil and water on site.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能三分钟生成一套标准课件，但「这块地今年该种什么」的答案，得蹲在田埂上、看了土和水之后才说得准。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年农场与家庭管理教育者在岗约 1.24 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.21 万人，岗位净减约 0.03 万个，年均产生约 0.11 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.81 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代农场与家庭管理教育者，但会接管课件和资料：课程初稿、资料整理、数据图表都能用 AI 快速生成，教育者的时间从「做课件」转向「跑现场、调方案」。实地指导、因地制宜的判断和面对面沟通，机器替代不了——教育这事，信任比内容更难建立。
ai_s2_accel: 线上课程与直播触达更多农户
AI 问答工具提供作物病虫害初步建议
农业数据平台辅助生产决策教学
短视频与案例库扩大示范效果
ai_s2_auto: 课件与讲义初稿的 AI 生成
课程资料与数据图表的自动整理
报名与学习进度管理数字化
课程反馈的自动收集与统计
ai_s3_list: 实地诊断：看土、看水、看作物，现场判断。
因地制宜：把通用知识调成当地能用的方案。
授课表达：把技术讲成农户听得懂的大白话。
信任建立：让农户愿意听、愿意试、愿意改。
需求洞察：听出服务对象真正缺什么。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这行的「资料性」环节正被 AI 提速——课件、整理、数据都能自动化；但「实地指导与面对面教学」是核心价值，需要现场判断和信任建立，评分高的是工具化部分，不是岗位本身。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于危险：会用线上课程、AI 工具扩大触达的教育者，服务半径更大、项目价值更明显。照本宣科、只会念课件的老师，才会被 AI 和在线课程替代。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选农业、教育类相关专业，大学多参加社会实践和下乡调研。这行适合真心愿意扎根基层、跟人打交道的人，证书和实地经验同样重要。
把数字化教学工具用起来，多攒优质案例。往项目负责人的方向走，从「上课的老师」升级成「能带项目、出效果」的推广专家。
有农业或教育背景的转岗合适，从培训专员或推广员做起。面试时突出你下过田、讲过课、解决过实际问题的经历，比学历更打动人。
这类岗位留人靠「项目稳定 + 成长通道 + 下乡补贴」；会线上课程、能沉淀案例的教育者，值得当成骨干培养，别只按课时算价值。

线上课程与 AI 工具扩大教育触达，线下实地指导价值更凸显。
项目化运营成为主流，能出效果、能沉淀案例的教育者更吃香。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can scan, classify, and retrieve records, but people still decide whether a file should be destroyed and who is authorized to access it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 84,300 File Clerks were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 70,900 by 2034, a net decrease of about 13,400 jobs, with about 7,300 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $41,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will substantially reduce the number of File Clerks. Automated scanning, intelligent classification, and semantic search already handle much filing and retrieval, and paper-only roles are shrinking quickly. Records appraisal, confidentiality levels, destruction approval, and complex retrieval still require people who understand policy and accept responsibility. The occupation is shifting toward records management and data governance.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted records appraisal and retention decisions
Intelligent processing of audio and visual records
ai_s2_auto: Automated loan registration and return reminders
ai_s3_list: Classification judgment: file ownership and retention periods.
Confidentiality control: access levels and loan approval.
Policy knowledge: records laws and business processes.
Retrieval expertise: paths for complex searches.
Emergency support: retrieving records for audits and disputes.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates moderate-high AI exposure in this administrative occupation. AI excels at scanning, classification, and retrieval, creating high replacement risk for operational roles. Policy management, confidentiality, and complex retrieval still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure requires active transition. Stop investing only in manual filing skills that systems can replace. Move toward records management, data governance, and information security. Using AI as a tool can shift the role from operator to administrator.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Students interested in administrative work can study records management, but should also learn confidentiality law, data management, and digital archives. Digital-records roles offer stronger prospects than traditional clerical work.
Learn digital archives platforms and AI search tools. Pursue professional records credentials or further study in information science. Moving from paper to data can improve both role level and pay.

Clerical workers can transition into records roles by learning records law, electronic-records management, and confidentiality systems. In interviews, explain the complete lifecycle of a document and emphasize organization and responsibility.
Improve records operations with systems rather than headcount. Digital archives platforms free staff from scanning and filing so they can focus on policy and data governance.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Complete outgoing and incoming document workflow

ai_s7_trends: Paperless operations and digital archives platforms continue reducing paper-only roles.
Records management is advancing toward data governance and information security.
Demand remains stable for people who understand records law and confidentiality management.

body: File Clerks receive, register, classify, file, scan, retrieve, and manage the lending of documents. They protect record integrity and confidentiality and keep information organized and searchable across paper and electronic systems.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can scan, classify, and retrieve records, but people still decide whether a file should be destroyed and who is authorized to access it.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动扫描、分类、检索档案，但「这份文件该不该销毁、谁有权限调阅」这种制度性判断，还得由人来定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年档案文员在岗约 8.43 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 7.09 万人，岗位净减约 1.34 万个，年均产生约 0.73 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.13 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 会大幅压缩档案文员的数量：自动扫描识别、智能分类、语义检索已经能处理大部分收归调工作，纯纸质操作岗在快速收缩。但档案的鉴定、保密分级、销毁审批和复杂调阅，需要懂制度、担责任的人，文员会向档案管理和数据治理转型。
ai_s2_accel: AI 档案鉴定与保管期限判断
语音与影像档案智能处理
公文自动化全流程管理
ai_s2_auto: 文件扫描与 OCR 识别
借阅登记与催还自动化
ai_s3_list: 分类判断：文件归属与保管期限。
保密把关：权限分级与借阅审核。
制度理解：档案法规与业务流程。
检索经验：复杂查档的路径设计。
应急配合：审计与纠纷调档。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明档案文员是「中高曝光」的行政岗位：扫描、分类、检索正是 AI 最擅长的，纯操作岗替代风险大；但制度管理、保密和复杂调阅仍需要人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光必须主动转型：别再练「手动归档」这种会被系统取代的技能，往档案管理师、数据治理、信息安全方向走，把 AI 当工具，你会从操作员变成管理员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入行政后勤的孩子，档案管理专业可以读但别只会归档：把保密法规、数据管理、档案信息化学起来，毕业后直接冲数字化档案岗，比传统文员有前途。
尽快掌握数字档案平台和 AI 检索工具，考档案专业职称或情报学进修，从「管纸」转向「管数据」，职位和薪资都会上一个台阶。
文员转档案岗有优势，重点补：档案法规、电子档案管理、保密制度；面试时强调条理性和责任感，能讲清楚「一份文件从进到出的完整流程」就加分。
档案岗效率提升靠系统不靠加人：引入数字档案平台，让员工从扫描归档里解放出来，转去做档案制度、数据治理，团队价值会明显提升。

ai_s7_trends: 无纸化与数字档案平台普及，纯纸质操作岗持续收缩。
档案管理向数据治理与信息安全方向升级。
懂档案法规与保密管理的人才需求稳定。

body: 档案文员（File Clerks）负责文件的接收、登记、分类、归档、扫描、检索与借阅管理，维护档案的完整与保密，在纸质与电子档案并存的机构中保障信息有序可查。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Scheduling and inventory systems can calculate accurately, but supervisors still spot which tables need turning and which employees are struggling that day.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 1,215,000 First Line Supervisors Of Food Preparation And Serving Workers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 1,288,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 73,000 jobs, with roughly 183,900 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $42,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace food-service supervisors, but it will assist their management work. Scheduling, ordering, and inventory systems speed up administrative tasks, shifting supervisors from recording schedules toward on-site coordination, team leadership, and complaint resolution. People who only maintain schedules face displacement, while leaders who can stabilize operations become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: On-site coordination: people control the pace.
Complaint resolution: people calm emotions.
Team leadership: people manage crew readiness.
Unexpected gaps: people step in when staffing fails.
Standards execution: people monitor compliance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range for management work. Systems accelerate scheduling and inventory tasks, while people retain on-site coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high job risk. Scheduling and recordkeeping tasks face displacement, not the leadership and operational recovery role. Supervisors who coordinate teams and stabilize service become scarcer as operations adopt more systems. People limited to schedule entry face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start on the front line and practice coordination and complaint resolution. Pure scheduling work is shrinking in the AI era, so build leadership skills early.
Advance from recording schedules to leading teams and stabilizing operations. Learn restaurant operations and management systems.
Highlight shift-leadership and complaint-resolution examples, and state the size of the operation you managed.
Do not select people only for diligence. Assess whether they can steady operations and lead a team. Supervisors who resolve disruptions deserve performance-based rewards.

ai_s7_trends: Chain expansion adds management roles.
Scheduling and inventory move onto digital systems.
Supervisors who lead teams and stabilize operations become more sought after.

body: First Line Supervisors Of Food Preparation And Serving Workers oversee front-line restaurant teams. They schedule shifts and food preparation, monitor meal fulfillment, sanitation, and service standards, resolve complaints, and keep on-site operations running smoothly.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 排班和库存系统能算得准，但哪桌要翻、谁今天状态差，还是主管一眼看出来的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年食品制备主管工人服务在岗约 121.50 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 128.80 万人，净增约 7.30 万个岗位，年均产生约 18.39 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.20 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代餐饮主管，但会辅助管理。排班、点单与库存系统把事务提速，主管从「记排班」挪向「现场协调 + 团队带领 + 客诉处理」。真正被挤掉的是只做排班记录的人，会带人能救火的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场协调：节奏靠人控。
客诉处理：情绪靠人抚。
团队带领：状态靠人带。
突发救火：缺人靠人顶。
标准落地：执行靠人盯。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的管理区——排班库存被系统提速，现场协调还留人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「排班与记录」动作，不是「带人和救火」的岗位。会协调、能扛场的人反而随系统化更稀缺。怕的是只会记排班的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 从一线做起，练协调和客诉。AI 时代纯排班在缩，早点练带人。
从「记排班」升级成「带团队 + 救火」，学运营和系统工具。
突出带班和客诉案例，写清管过多大店。
选人别只看勤快，看能不能扛场带人。能救火的主管值得给绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 连锁扩张，管理岗增。
排班库存上系统。
会带人能救火的主管更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Tools can run standard simulations, but engineers still decide which formulations to adjust and how to integrate a stable system.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 293,100 Fuel Cell Engineers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 319,600 by 2034, adding about 26,500 jobs and producing roughly 18,100 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $102,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Fuel Cell Engineers, but it will reduce standard design work. Simulation and automated test stands accelerate routine engineering. Engineers shift from stack drawings to formulation tuning, system integration, durability, and architecture. Workers limited to standard simulations face pressure, while strong materials and integration skills gain value.
ai_s3_list: Formulation tuning: people develop practical judgment.
System integration: people balance competing requirements.
Materials coordination: people uncover real constraints.
Durability improvement: people choose tradeoffs.
System architecture: people define boundaries.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in a moderate-high AI-exposure area of electrochemistry. Systems accelerate standard design, while tuning and integration preserve a central human role.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high job risk. Automation replaces standard simulation, not formulation tuning and integration. Engineers who integrate stacks for volume production become scarcer as productivity rises. Workers limited to standard simulations face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A chemical-engineering or materials background provides a useful start. Study electrochemistry and systems because routine simulation is shrinking. Build integration skills early.
Move from stack drawings into materials tuning and production-line coordination. Learn process engineering and durability analysis.
Emphasize stack and volume-production experience. Describe the development stages you have supported.
Do not hire only for academic credentials. Assess troubleshooting judgment and the ability to move designs into production. Engineers who deliver production readiness warrant higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Simulation absorbs standard design work.
Integration and durability receive greater attention.
Engineers with strong troubleshooting skills are increasingly valuable.

body: Fuel Cell Engineers lead the design, simulation, and validation of stacks and systems. They coordinate catalysts, membrane electrode assemblies, and thermal management to deliver power and durability.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Tools can run standard simulations, but engineers still decide which formulations to adjust and how to integrate a stable system.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 工具能跑标准仿真，但哪种配方该调、怎么集到系统稳，还是工程师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代燃料电池工程师，但会压缩标准设计。仿真与自动台架把常规设计提速，工程师从「画电堆」挪向「配方调试、系统集成、寿命提升、架构」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准仿真的，有集成力和材料力的人更值钱。

系统集成：权衡靠人。

寿命提升：取舍靠人。
系统架构：边界靠人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的电化学区——标准设计被系统加速，但调试与集成还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准仿真」动作，不是「配方调试与集成」的岗位。有集成力、能把电堆调量产的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会跑标准仿真的工程师。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 化工 / 材料起步多学电化学与系统，AI 时代纯仿真在缩，早点练集成。
从「画电堆」升级成「调材料 + 对接产线」，学工艺和寿命。
突出电堆与量产经验，写清跟过哪些环节。
选人别只看学历，要看有没有调试脑子。能推量产的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 仿真吃标准设计。
集成与寿命更被重。
有调试力的工程师更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Machine-vision sorters can classify large volumes of fruit by color and size almost instantly, but experienced workers still judge whether bruising will affect appearance after long-distance transport.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 38,900 workers in 2024, projected to decline to 36,800 by 2034. That is a net decrease of about 2,100 jobs, with roughly 5,100 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $35,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is rapidly changing agricultural grading. Machine-vision sorters automatically classify by color, size, and weight far faster than people, reducing visual grading roles. Grading also requires judgments about maturity, storage and flavor effects of damage, and customer quality preferences. Human quality inspectors still provide assurance, while workers shift from visual sorting toward monitoring equipment, sampling results, and defining standards.
ai_s2_accel: AI vision recognition of mold, internal damage, and other defects
Spectral testing for sweetness and maturity
Intelligent packaging lines matched automatically to grades
ai_s2_auto: Machine-vision grading by color and size
Automatic weight and count classification into containers
Automatic conveyor and robotic removal of defective products
Automatic grading data and batch records
ai_s3_list: Judge how damage affects storage and flavor.
Understand customer grading preferences through experience.
Sample and verify machine sorting errors.
Switch flexibly among grading standards for different products.
Organize seasonal labor and manage the worksite.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this occupation in a low-moderate AI exposure range. Machine vision is clearly replacing repetitive appearance grading, while people remain necessary for quality verification, standard setting, and anomaly judgment. Pure visual grading roles will decline, while workers who understand equipment and quality control become more valuable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still creates clear pressure. Workers who learn sorting equipment, understand grading data, and master quality standards can move into quality inspection and production-line management. People who depend only on visual judgment and avoid new skills face replacement first.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This can be useful seasonal transition work, but it is not an ideal long-term plan. People seeking an agricultural career should develop toward agricultural inspection or food quality management by learning grading standards, inspection knowledge, and data processing.

Master machine-vision sorting, data traceability, and quality standards, then advance toward Quality Inspector, packaging team lead, or production-line management. Grading experience is valuable capital for moving into quality assurance.

Seasonal entry requirements are low, making this a quick transition role. Observe quality inspection and control jobs, proactively learn standards and equipment, and use seasonal work as a bridge to stable employment.

Do not manage Graders and Sorters only as temporary labor. Provide permanent pathways for people willing to learn equipment and inspection, and retain experienced human quality-control roles alongside machine sorting to balance efficiency with quality.

Assess sweetness, maturity, and internal damage
Package products automatically by weight grade
Automatically match packaging plans to grades
Recognize mold, pest damage, and mechanical damage
Real-time grading yield and output statistics
Sample and verify machine grading results

ai_s7_trends: Machine-vision sorting is spreading and substantially reducing manual appearance grading roles.
Higher quality and traceability requirements increase demand for quality-oriented grading workers.
Fresh-food e-commerce and industrial processing drive more detailed grading standards.

body: Graders and Sorters, Agricultural Products classify fruits, vegetables, eggs, grains, and other products by size, weight, color, maturity, and damage, remove defective items, and support packaging and quality-control processes.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Machine-vision sorters can classify large volumes of fruit by color and size almost instantly, but experienced workers still judge whether bruising will affect appearance after long-distance transport.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 机器视觉分拣机能在一秒里分清上百个果子的颜色和大小，但「这批苹果的磕碰会不会影响长途运输后的卖相」这种判断，还得靠老分拣员把关。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年分级与分拣员、产品在岗约 3.89 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.68 万人，岗位净减约 0.21 万个，年均产生约 0.51 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.54 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 正在快速改变农产品分级：机器视觉分拣机按颜色、大小、重量自动分级，速度远超人工，外观分级岗位明显减少。但分级不只是看外观——成熟度、损伤对储存和口感的影响、客户对品质的挑剔，这些经验判断仍需人工质检兜底。分拣员的定位正从「用眼睛分」转向「盯机器 + 抽检复核 + 定标准」。
ai_s2_accel: AI 视觉扩展识别霉变、内部损伤等缺陷
光谱检测辅助评估甜度与成熟度
数据追溯系统实现分级批次全程可查
智能包装线按等级自动匹配包装方案
ai_s2_auto: 机器视觉按颜色、大小自动分级
称重与计数设备自动分档装筐
传送带与机械臂自动剔除次品
分级数据与批次记录自动生成
ai_s3_list: 损伤对储存与口感的影响判断。
客户分级偏好的经验把握。
机器分拣误差的抽检与复核。
多品种分级标准的灵活切换。
产季用工的组织与现场管理。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处于「人工分级被机器视觉替代」的明确进程中：外观分级这类重复劳动在快速自动化，但质检复核、标准制定和异常判断仍需要人。纯眼力分级员会减少，懂设备、能质检的分拣骨干更吃香。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于没机会：学会操作分拣设备、看懂分级数据、掌握品质标准的人，可以转向质检员和产线管理。越是依赖纯眼力、不学新东西的分拣员，越容易排在替代名单前面。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 作为季节性过渡工作可以，但不建议当长期规划。若孩子想深耕农业，往农业检验、食品质量管理方向发展更有前景，把分级标准、质检知识和数据处理学起来。
把机器视觉分拣、数据追溯和品质标准学透，往质检员、包装线班组长或产线管理走。分级经验是你转型质检最大的资本，别浪费在纯重复分拣上。
产季入职门槛低，适合快速上手的过渡期岗位。入行后注意观察企业的质检和品控岗位，主动学习标准与设备，把季节性工作变成通向稳定岗位的跳板。
别把分拣员当纯临时工管理，给愿意学设备和质检的人转正通道。机器分拣之外，保留经验丰富的人工质检岗，才能平衡效率与品质。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 按颜色、大小、重量快速分级

分级合格率与产量实时统计
抽检复核机器分级结果

ai_s7_trends: 机器视觉分拣普及，外观分级人工岗位明显减少。
品质与追溯要求升级，质检型分级人员需求上升。
生鲜电商与产业化加工推动分级标准更精细。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can lend and search, but assistants still handle reader questions and organize collections.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 84,500 clerical library assistants employed in 2024, projected to fall to 78,900 by 2034. That is a net decrease of about 5,600 jobs, with roughly 12,800 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $36,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace library assistants, but it will reduce transactional tasks. Self-service lending and research systems accelerate basic procedures, shifting assistants toward reader consultation, collection organization, and program support. Lending-only roles face pressure, while people who research and serve readers become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Reader consultation: people interpret needs.
Collection organization: people maintain order.
Program support: people organize activities.
Readers with special needs: people provide patience.
On-site coordination: people adapt.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this occupation at moderate-high exposure in clerical work. Systems accelerate lending and research, while people retain responsibility for consultation and organization.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces lending procedures, not roles that organize collections and serve readers well. Assistants with research and service skills become scarcer as productivity rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in circulation and build research and service skills. Pure lending work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop consultation skills early.
Advance from processing transactions to consultation plus cataloging support, then pursue senior library roles.
Emphasize attention to detail and reader-service examples, clearly identifying the systems you have used.
Do not hire on credentials alone. Look for attention to detail; people who keep collections accurate merit stable roles.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service lending spreads as transaction work contracts.
Digital resources increase, raising consultation demand.
People who combine research with service become more sought after.

body: Clerical library assistants handle circulation and collection operations, coordinating lending and returns, shelving, catalog maintenance, reader questions, and system reconciliation to keep materials organized and findable.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can lend and search, but assistants still handle reader questions and organize collections.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能借能查，但读者咨询和馆藏整理，还是助理定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年图书馆文书助理在岗约 8.45 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 7.89 万人，岗位净减约 0.56 万个，年均产生约 1.28 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.60 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代图书馆助理，但会压缩事务动作。自助借还与检索系统把基础事务提速，助理从办手续挪向读者咨询、馆藏整理与活动支持。真正被挤掉的是只办借还的，会检索能服务的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 读者咨询：需求靠人。
馆藏整理：秩序靠人。
活动支持：组织靠人。
特殊读者：耐心靠人。
现场协调：应变靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的文职区——借还检索被系统加速，但咨询和整理还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是借还手续动作，不是把馆藏理清楚、把读者服务好的岗位。会检索、能服务的助理，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 从流通助理起，多练检索和服务，AI 时代纯借还在缩，早点练咨询。
从办手续升级成咨询加编目辅助，争取资深馆员。
突出细致和读者服务案例，写清用过哪些系统。
选人别只看学历，要看细不细。能把馆藏理透的人值得给稳定岗。

ai_s7_trends: 自助借还普及，手续缩。
数字资源升，咨询增。
会检索服务的更抢手。

career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能借能查，但读者咨询和馆藏整理，还是助理定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Routes can be scheduled automatically, but drivers still decide which addresses justify a detour, how to handle exceptions, and how to communicate with customers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 1,079,800 light truck drivers employed in 2024, projected to reach 1,158,600 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 78,800 jobs, with roughly 120,200 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $44,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace light truck drivers, but it will reduce dispatch work. Routing and automatic assignment accelerate routine operations, shifting drivers from waiting for jobs toward last-mile decisions, customer communication, exception handling, and vehicle checks. Fixed-route-only driving faces replacement, while people who solve problems and communicate become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Last-mile decisions: people resolve unexpected events.
Complex addresses: people find the route.
Customer communication: people secure delivery acceptance.
Exception handling: people manage address changes.
Vehicle checks: people assure safety.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this occupation at moderate-high exposure in delivery work. Systems accelerate routing, while people retain responsibility for last-mile delivery and exceptions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure still carries risk. AI replaces fixed-route driving tasks, not last-mile decisions. Drivers who resolve issues and communicate become scarcer as productivity rises; fixed-route-only drivers face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with the required license and build routing and problem-solving skills. Pure route driving is shrinking in the AI era, so develop communication early.
Advance from waiting for assignments to last-mile solutions plus customer service. Learn dispatch data and pursue stable major accounts.
Emphasize years of driving and local-route knowledge, clearly identifying the areas you have covered. Logistics employers value steadiness and punctuality.
Do not hire on the license alone. Look for problem-solving judgment; core drivers who handle exceptions merit better routes.

ai_s7_trends: Route automation reduces dispatch work.
Last-mile problem solving creates opportunities.
Drivers with strong problem-solving skills become more sought after.

body: Light truck drivers operate light trucks for local pickup and delivery, handling loading, routing, acceptance, and exceptions to assure timely and safe last-mile distribution.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Routes can be scheduled automatically, but drivers still decide which addresses justify a detour, how to handle exceptions, and how to communicate with customers.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 路由能自动排，但哪类地址值得绕、怎么处置异常、客户怎么沟通，还是司机定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年轻型卡车司机在岗约 107.98 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 115.86 万人，净增约 7.88 万个岗位，年均产生约 12.02 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.41 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代轻型卡车司机，但会压缩调度。路由与自动派单把常规提速，司机从「等派单」挪向「末端处置、客户沟通、异常处理、车辆自检」。真正被替的是纯跑固定线的，有处置力能沟通的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 末端处置：突发靠人解。
复杂地址：找路靠人。
客户沟通：签收靠人。
异常处理：改址靠人。
车辆自检：安全靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的配送区——路由被系统加速，但末端与处置还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于无风险：被替代的是「跑固定线」动作，不是「末端处置」的岗位。有处置力、能沟通的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会跑固定线的司机。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 持证起步多练路由和处置，AI 时代纯跑线在缩，早点练沟通。
从「等派单」升级成「末端处置 + 客户」，学调度数据，争取固定大客。
突出驾龄和熟线，写清跑过哪些区。物流看重稳和准。
选人别只看驾照，要看处置脑子。能顶异常的骨干，值得给高线。

ai_s7_trends: 路由自动化，调度缩。
末端处置有机会。
有处置力的司机更抢手。

body: 轻型卡车司机驾驶轻卡完成本地货物的取送，负责装卸、路由、签收与异常处理，保障末端配送的时效与安全。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 路由能自动排，但哪类地址值得绕、怎么处置异常、客户怎么沟通，还是司机定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: License plate recognition can raise the barrier automatically, but when an SUV gets stuck in a narrow space during a downpour, an attendant still has to step out and guide it in reverse.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 135,700 parking attendants were employed in 2024. ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace parking attendants, but it will take over payment and identification. License plate recognition and automated payment eliminate card-collection posts, shifting attendants from collecting money toward directing traffic, valet parking, and emergency supervision. People who only collect cards without moving vehicles face displacement, while those who valet and handle emergencies become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent assignment of valet parking jobs
Video monitoring for occupied spaces and anomalies
Prediction and routing of peak traffic
ai_s2_auto: License plate recognition and frictionless payment raise barriers automatically
Automated parking guidance and vacancy displays
Remote centralized control of barriers and equipment
ai_s3_list: On-site guidance: people direct traffic at bottlenecks.
Valet parking: people reverse into narrow spaces.
Emergency supervision: people handle leaks and accidents.
Dispute resolution: people negotiate over occupied spaces.
Special vehicles: people receive large vehicles and VIPs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates that this occupation has moderately high exposure in on-site services. Systems take over identification and payment, while people retain their role in guidance and valet parking.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Collecting cards and money faces replacement, not vehicle-guidance roles. Attendants who provide valet parking and handle emergencies become scarcer as cashierless systems spread. People limited to collecting cards face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This low-barrier field offers quick entry, but do not stop at card collection. Develop valet and emergency-response skills early and advance toward parking-shift supervisor.
Advance from card collection to valet parking + traffic routing. Learn dispatching and complaint handling, then pursue parking operations roles.
Highlight valet experience and driving history, clearly stating the types of venues served. Parking operations value composure and courtesy.
When hiring, do not focus solely on low cost. Assess valet and traffic-routing ability. People who handle emergencies deserve higher commissions.

ai_s7_trends: Cashierless payment is spreading, eliminating card-collection posts.
Demand remains stable for valet parking and facility guidance.
Parking roles are becoming combinations of operations and dispatching.

body: Parking attendants guide vehicles, collect fees, issue receipts, supervise spaces, and provide valet parking at lots and garages. They maintain traffic order and vehicle safety so drivers enter, exit, and park properly.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 车牌识别能把杆自动抬起来，但暴雨里一辆 SUV 卡在窄位，还是 attendant 下车指挥倒进去。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年停车服务员在岗约 13.57 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 13.98 万人，净增约 0.41 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.85 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.46 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。

高峰车流的预测与引流

车位诱导与空位显示的自动化
收费与对账的自动生成
道闸与设备的远程集中控制

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「收卡收钱」动作，不是「引导泊车」的岗位。会代客泊车、能应急的人，反而随无人收费更稀缺。怕的是只会收卡的老 attendant。

代客泊车与场站引导需求稳。
车场向运营与调度复合岗走。

body: 停车服务员在停车场与车库负责车辆引导、收费开票、车位看护与代客泊车，维持场内交通秩序与车辆安全，保障车主顺畅进出与规范停放。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 车牌识别能把杆自动抬起来，但暴雨里一辆 SUV 卡在窄位，还是 attendant 下车指挥倒进去。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can monitor refractory-lining wear automatically through thermal imaging, but workers entering the furnace still decide whether a brick needs replacement and how to ram castable material.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,100 refractory materials repairers were employed in 2024, falling to a projected 900 by 2034, a net decrease of about 200 jobs, with approximately 100 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $58,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace refractory materials repairers. Lining repair combines physical strength and craft in high-temperature environments, where robots cannot soon enter furnaces to work. AI helps with thermal inspection, wear prediction, and maintenance scheduling, calculating when repairs are needed more accurately, but people still determine how to repair.
ai_s2_accel: Thermal imaging inspection of lining wear
AI prediction of refractory service life
ai_s3_list: Damage judgment: determine repair and replacement scope from cracks and erosion.
Construction technique: masonry, ramming, and casting expertise.
Material knowledge: select refractories for different furnaces and kilns.
Field adaptability: work in confined spaces and high temperatures.
Safety competence: hot-work and confined-space procedures.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 means refractory repair is a heavy-industry craft with low AI exposure. The unusual, strenuous work environment makes physical labor and field experience central, while AI only assists monitoring, scheduling, and records.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not justify complacency. As steel mills become more intelligent, repairers who interpret thermal data and understand refractory-life prediction can advance from laborers into equipment-savvy specialists with greater influence over repair plans.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Young people entering this field should understand that it involves heavy physical labor. Physical fitness is essential, and safety procedures at maintenance sites must be mastered first. Backgrounds in refractories, materials, or welding offer stronger prospects in refractory technical services.

Advance toward refractory technician and maintenance management. Learn new castables and spraying techniques, earn specialized-work certificates, and use temperature data and maintenance records to gain influence over repair plans.

People with masonry, welding, or furnace-operation experience can transition by learning refractory processes with a maintenance crew, emphasizing material proportions and ramming technique. In interviews, highlight endurance, specialized-work certificates, and safety knowledge.

Refractory maintenance crews are difficult to recruit. Retain workers through high maintenance-period pay + off-season rotations + proper safety equipment. Convert veteran expertise into process standards and use automated monitoring to reduce ineffective inspections.

ai_s6_tools.工具: Furnace and kiln operations monitoring platform

ai_s7_trends: Steel mill modernization creates condition-based maintenance roles through digital twins.
Hydrogen metallurgy, new-energy kilns, and other processes create new demand for advanced refractories.
Spraying and mechanization upgrade refractory installation, reducing pure manual labor.

body: Refractory materials repairers, except brickmasons, remove, rebuild, cast, repair, and maintain refractory linings in industrial furnaces and kilns, monitor wear, and protect safe and stable operation of high-temperature equipment.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can monitor refractory-lining wear automatically through thermal imaging, but workers entering the furnace still decide whether a brick needs replacement and how to ram castable material.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能靠热成像自动监测炉衬损耗，但「这块砖要不要换、浇注料怎么捣打」的现场判断，还得靠钻进炉膛的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年耐火材料、砌砖工在岗约 0.11 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.09 万人，岗位净减约 0.02 万个，年均产生约 0.01 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.85 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代耐火材料修理工：炉衬修补是高强度、高温环境下的体力加手艺活，机器人短时间内进不了炉膛干活；AI 能帮的是热成像巡检、损耗预测和检修排程，把「什么时候该修」算得更准，但「怎么修」仍靠人手。
ai_s2_accel: AI 预测耐材使用寿命
ai_s2_auto: 检修记录与报表数字化
ai_s3_list: 破损判断：从裂纹和侵蚀判断换修范围。
施工手法：砌筑、捣打、浇注的功夫。
材料知识：不同炉窑的耐材选型。
现场应变：狭小空间与高温作业。
安全素养：动火与受限空间规程。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明耐火材料维修是「低 AI 曝光」的重工业手艺：作业环境特殊、强度高，核心是体力与经验的现场劳动，AI 只能在监测、排程、记录上帮忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光也不宜躺平：钢厂智能化改造在推进，会看热成像数据、懂耐材寿命预测的修理工，能从「干活的」变成「懂设备的」，检修方案的话语权都不一样。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入这行的年轻人要清楚是重体力活：身体是前提，先把检修现场的安全规程学透。耐材、材料或焊接类专业背景的，往耐材技术服务方向走更有前途。
往耐材技术员和检修管理走：学新型浇注料、喷涂技术，考特种作业证书；把测温数据和检修记录用起来，你会成为检修方案里说得上话的人。
有砌筑、焊接或炉窑操作经验的可以转：先跟检修班组学耐材工艺，重点是材料配比和捣打手法；面试时强调能吃苦、有特种作业证、懂安全。
耐材检修班组难招人，建议「检修期高薪 + 淡季轮休 + 安全装备到位」留人；把老师傅的经验做成工艺标准，用自动化监测减少无效巡检。

ai_s7_trends: 钢厂智能化改造带来耐材寿命预测与远程监测。
氢冶金、新能源窑炉等新工艺带动高端耐材需求。
耐材施工向喷涂与机械化升级，纯体力工减少。

body: 耐火材料修理工（除砌砖工外）对工业炉窑的耐火材料内衬进行拆砌、浇注、修补与维护，监控炉衬损耗，保障高温设备安全稳定运行。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能靠热成像自动监测炉衬损耗，但「这块砖要不要换、浇注料怎么捣打」的现场判断，还得靠钻进炉膛的人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate the optimal lift plan, but only someone who has handled wire rope and rigged loads knows where a machine's center of gravity lies and whether a sling arrangement can bear the force.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 24,600 riggers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 25,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 800 jobs, with about 2,500 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $62,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace riggers. Securing loads, attaching rigging, and judging lifting points must be done by hand on site, and only certified workers can bear safety responsibility. AI can optimize load calculations and lift plans, but machines cannot replace the practical skill of transferring a heavy load safely to a crane.
ai_s2_auto: Automated work records and inspection checklists
Systematic rigging inventory and retirement alerts
ai_s3_list: Hands-on rigging: practical mastery of knots and securing methods.
Lifting-point judgment: experience selecting centers of gravity and angles.
Rigging inspection: on-site ability to spot wear and hazards.
Signal coordination: seamless teamwork with crane operators.
Safety responsibility: accountability throughout lifting operations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 shows that rigging is a high-risk skilled trade where AI clearly improves efficiency but people remain essential. Software handles load calculations and plan documentation, while securing loads, attaching rigging, and making on-site judgments still depend heavily on human hands and experience. People alone bear safety responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-to-moderate exposure does not mean no change. Digital lift simulations and smart rigging are spreading. Riggers who use these tools can handle more complex heavy lifts and earn more, while project owners will be more selective about people who rely only on old experience and do not learn new tools.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Children who want to learn a trade quickly and do not seek high academic requirements can start as apprentices. Parents must understand that this work involves serious risks from heights and heavy loads, so safety awareness must begin on the first day. Obtain complete certifications for work at height and lifting signal operations to support advancement.

Specialize in heavy and specialized lifting and learn digital lift-planning tools. Crew leadership and lift direction are promotion paths, and experienced riggers with strong safety records are the most sought after on projects.

People with construction, machinery, or welding backgrounds transition smoothly. Begin as an apprentice to build rigging experience, then work independently after certification. In interviews, emphasize adaptability to work at height and safety awareness; certified applicants receive priority.

Riggers have high turnover. Retain them through project bonuses + safety incentives + certification allowances. Capture experienced workers' knowledge in standard operating instructions, and use digital planning tools to lower the learning barrier for newcomers.

ai_s7_trends: Digital lift plans and smart rigging are entering major projects.
Infrastructure and new energy, including wind power, are driving demand for heavy lifting.
Certification and safety oversight are tightening, increasing demand for technically skilled riggers.

body: Riggers select, inspect, and operate rigging during lifting work. They secure loads, determine lifting points and angles, and coordinate with hoisting machinery to lift, move, and place heavy objects safely.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate the optimal lift plan, but only someone who has handled wire rope and rigged loads knows where a machine's center of gravity lies and whether a sling arrangement can bear the force.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出最优吊装方案，但「这台设备的重心在哪、吊带这样绑吃不吃得住力」——只有摸过钢丝绳、挂过吊的人心里有数。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年索具工在岗约 2.46 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.54 万人，净增约 0.08 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.25 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.21 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代索具工：绑扎、挂吊、吊点判断都必须在现场亲手完成，安全责任更是只能由持证作业人员承担。AI 能优化载荷计算和吊装方案，但「把重物稳稳交给吊车」的手上功夫，机器替不了。
ai_s2_auto: 作业记录与检查表自动生成
索具台账与报废提醒系统化
ai_s3_list: 绑扎手艺：各种绳结与绑法的实操。
吊点判断：重心与角度选择经验。
索具检查：磨损与隐患的现场眼力。
信号协作：与吊车司机的默契配合。
安全担当：吊装过程的责任把控。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明索具作业是「AI 明显提效、但核心靠人」的高危技术工种：载荷计算和方案文档被软件接管，而绑扎、挂吊和现场判断依然高度依赖人的双手与经验，安全责任只能人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低中分不等于不变：数字化吊装模拟和智能索具在普及，会用这些工具的索具工能承担更复杂的大件吊装，收入也更高；只靠老经验不学新工具的人会被项目方挑剔。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历要求不高、想尽快学门手艺的孩子可以入行，从学徒开始。要跟家长讲清楚：这行高空重物风险高，安全意识必须从第一天抓起；建议考全高处作业和起重指挥证，为晋升打基础。
往大件吊装和特种吊装方向深耕，把数字化吊装方案工具学起来。带班和指挥方向是晋升路径，安全记录好的老索具工在项目上最抢手。
有建筑、机械、焊工背景的转行顺。先跟班做学徒积累绑扎经验，考证后独立作业；面试时强调高处作业适应力和安全意识，有证的优先。
索具工流动性大，用「项目提成 + 安全奖励 + 持证补贴」留人。老师傅的经验要沉淀成标准作业指导书，同时配数字化方案工具降低新人的上手门槛。

ai_s7_trends: 数字化吊装方案与智能索具进入大型项目。
基建与新能源（风电）带动大件吊装需求。
持证与安全监管趋严，技术型索具工更吃香。

body: 索具工（Riggers）在吊装作业中负责索具的选择、检查与操作，绑扎固定待吊物体、确定吊点与角度，配合起重机械完成重物的起吊、移动与落位，保障吊装作业安全。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能算出最优吊装方案，但「这台设备的重心在哪、吊带这样绑吃不吃得住力」——只有摸过钢丝绳、挂过吊的人心里有数。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate standard courseware and recorded lessons, but teachers still decide how to engage learners, encourage practice, and retain students.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 417,500 self-enrichment teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 433,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 15,500 jobs, with approximately 51,400 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $45,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace self-enrichment teachers, but it will reduce standardized roles. Recorded lessons and AI courseware take over standardizable content, shifting teachers from delivering content toward guided practice, interaction, motivation, community building, and course renewals. People who only play videos and read scripts will be displaced, while those who can coach practice and retain students will become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Face-to-face guided practice: people provide the feel for the work.
Interaction and motivation: people support emotions.
Correction and demonstration: people address details.
Local communities: people build trust.
Course-renewal management: people maintain relationships.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in a medium AI-exposure teaching category. Standard content moves online, while guided practice and companionship remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Playing videos and reading scripts are being replaced, not roles centered on guided practice and motivation. As content production becomes more efficient, teachers who can coach students and retain them become even scarcer. Those who only teach mechanically from a script face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you have an area of expertise, develop teaching skills and learn guided practice and student recruitment early because recorded-only instruction is contracting.
Advance from delivering content to guided practice + community building, and develop a signature course.
Highlight professional credentials and teaching volume, clearly stating which learner groups you have taught.
Do not select teachers solely for their own skill level; assess whether they can coach and retain students.

ai_s7_trends: As recorded lessons become widespread, demand for standard content shrinks.
Guided practice and communities retain students.
Signature courses receive greater emphasis.

body: Self-enrichment teachers provide nondegree interest and skills instruction to adults and recreational learners. They design guided-practice courses, provide progress feedback, and maintain the classroom atmosphere, serving as supportive teachers in lifelong learning.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate standard courseware and recorded lessons, but teachers still decide how to engage learners, encourage practice, and retain students.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能生成标准课件与录播，但怎么把人带起来、怎么哄着练、怎么留住学员，还是老师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年自我提升课程教师在岗约 41.75 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 43.30 万人，净增约 1.55 万个岗位，年均产生约 5.14 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.56 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代自我提升教师，但会压缩标准岗。录播与 AI 课件接管可标准化的内容，老师从「讲内容」挪向「带练、互动、激励、社群与续课」。真正被挤掉的是只放视频念稿的，会带练能留人的更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 面对面带练：手感靠人。
互动激励：情绪靠人。
纠偏示范：细节靠人。
本地社群：信任靠人。
续课经营：关系靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的教学区——标准内容被线上化，但带练与陪伴还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「放视频念稿」动作，不是「带练与激励」的岗位。会带、能留人的老师，反而随内容提效更稀缺。怕的是只会照本宣科。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 有专长就练教学，早点学带练和招生，纯录播在缩。
从「讲内容」升级成「带练 + 社群」，做招牌课。
突出专长背书和带课量，写清教过哪些人群。
选人别只看水平，要看会不会带和留人。

ai_s7_trends: 录播普及，标准内容缩。
带练与社群留人。
招牌课更被看重。

body: 自我提升课程教师面向成人及业余学员提供非学历的兴趣与技能教学，设计带练课程、反馈进度并维持课堂氛围，是终身学习里的陪伴型教学岗。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能生成标准课件与录播，但怎么把人带起来、怎么哄着练、怎么留住学员，还是老师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Models can perform calculations, but scientists still decide how to sample soil, balance solutions, and communicate with farmers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 20,700 soil and plant scientists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 21,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,100 jobs, with about 1,700 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $71,400 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace these roles, but it will accelerate analysis and modeling. Remote sensing and data models speed up routine analysis, shifting people from calculating data toward sampling design, field judgment, balancing solutions, and extension communication. Those who only perform standardized laboratory tests face displacement, while people who can design studies and weigh tradeoffs become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Sampling design: people choose the sampling locations.
Field judgment: people assess the land.
Balancing solutions: people weigh the tradeoffs.
Extension communication: trust depends on people.
Research design: people develop the ideas.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 indicates moderately high exposure. Systems accelerate remote sensing and modeling, but people retain an essential role in sampling and decision-making.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is standardized laboratory testing, not roles that understand the land. People who can design studies and weigh tradeoffs become scarcer as productivity rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a strong foundation in agronomy and statistics. Pure laboratory testing is shrinking, so develop design and decision-making skills early.
Advance from laboratory testing to modeling plus extension plus research, and seek opportunities to lead research projects.
Highlight field experience and research outcomes. Research institutes value practical expertise and specialization.
When hiring, look beyond academic qualifications and assess whether candidates can design studies and communicate. Core contributors who can set a direction deserve a strong platform.

ai_s7_trends: Remote sensing and modeling become widespread, reducing laboratory testing.
Balancing solutions receives greater weight.
Professionals with design skills are in greater demand.

body: Soil And Plant Scientists study soil properties and their relationship to plant nutrition and growth. They use sampling, laboratory testing, and modeling to recommend fertilization, crop rotation, and conservation practices for agriculture and ecosystems.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Models can perform calculations, but scientists still decide how to sample soil, balance solutions, and communicate with farmers.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 建模能算，但土怎么取、方案怎么权衡、农民怎么沟通，还是科学家的人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年土壤与植物科学家在岗约 2.07 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.18 万人，净增约 0.11 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.14 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类岗位，但会加速分析与建模。遥感与数据建模把常规分析提速，人从「算数据」挪向「取样设计、田间判断、方案权衡、推广沟通」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准化验的，会设计、能权衡的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 取样设计：布点靠人。
田间判断：看地靠人。
方案权衡：平衡靠人。
推广沟通：信任靠人。
科研设计：思路靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光——遥感与建模被系统加速，但取样与决策还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准化验」动作，不是「读懂土地」的岗位。会设计、能权衡的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 打好农学与统计，纯化验在缩，早点练设计与权衡。
从「化验」升级成「建模 + 推广 + 科研」，争取课题。
突出田间与成果，院所看重实和专。
选人别只看学历，要看会不会设计和沟通，能立方向的骨干值得给平台。

ai_s7_trends: 遥感建模普及，化验缩。
方案权衡更被看重。
会设计的人更抢手。

body: 土壤与植物科学家研究土壤性质与植物营养、生长的关系，通过取样化验与建模提出施肥、轮作与保护方案，服务农业与生态。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 建模能算，但土怎么取、方案怎么权衡、农民怎么沟通，还是科学家的人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated loading systems can fill according to a formula, but experienced loaders still determine which connection is not properly sealed and whether an alarm requires shutdown.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 12,000 tank car and truck loaders were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 12,500 by 2034, a net gain of about 500 jobs, with about 1,300 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $58,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace loaders, but it will deeply automate their work. Automated loading, load optimization, and sensor monitoring accelerate routine operations, shifting workers from manual filling toward safety supervision, exception handling, and system maintenance. Pure operating roles limited to routine connections will face pressure, while people who interpret instruments and respond to emergencies will become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Safety decisions: People decide whether to stop operations.
On-site emergency response: People handle leaks.
Seal inspections: People verify them visually.
Procedure compliance: People maintain discipline.
Anomaly recognition: People rely on experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in the moderately high exposure range for automation. Systems take over routine loading while people move into monitoring and exception handling.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean complete replacement. AI replaces routine connection and filling tasks, not safety-supervision roles. People who read instruments, respond to emergencies, and follow procedures will become scarcer as automation spreads. Pure operators who only connect hoses are most vulnerable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through vocational school and earn a special-operations certificate early. Pure operating work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop safety and instrument skills.
Advance from connecting hoses to monitoring and maintenance. Learn sensor and system tools.
Highlight credentials and safety records, specifying the materials you have handled.
Do not hire based only on speed. Assess safety awareness and emergency response. Loaders who protect safety merit higher hazard pay.

ai_s7_trends: Automated loading is spreading, reducing pure operating roles.
Sensors and alerts are becoming standard.
Workers who monitor systems and respond to emergencies are in greater demand.

body: Tank car, truck, and ship loaders safely load liquids, gases, and bulk materials into tank cars and ship holds. They operate loading arms and pumps, verify documents and measurements, monitor pressure and liquid levels, and strictly follow safety procedures as frontline guardians of hazardous-material handling.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated loading systems can fill according to a formula, but experienced loaders still determine which connection is not properly sealed and whether an alarm requires shutdown.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动装车系统能按配方灌装，但哪根管没密封好、报警该不该停，还是装载工凭经验定的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年罐体车辆、卡车在岗约 1.20 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.25 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.13 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.81 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代装载工，但会深度自动化。自动装车、配载优化与传感器监控把常规操作提速，工人从「手动灌装」挪向「安全监督 + 异常处理 + 系统运维」。真正被挤掉的是只做常规连接的纯操作岗，会看仪表能应急的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 安全判断：该停不该停靠人。
现场应急：泄漏靠人处。
密封检查：靠人眼定。
规范执行：纪律靠人守。
异常识别：经验靠人辨。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的自动化区——常规装载被系统接管，人退到监控与异常。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于全替代：被替代的是「常规连接与灌装」动作，不是「安全监督」的岗位。会看仪表、能应急、守规范的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。怕的是只会机械接管的纯操作工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 职校打底，早点考特种作业证。AI 时代纯操作在缩，练安全和仪表。
从「接管」升级成「监护 + 运维」，学传感器和系统工具。
突出持证和安全记录，写清跟过哪些介质。
选人别只看手快，看安全意识和应急。能守安全的装载工值得给高津贴。

ai_s7_trends: 自动装车普及，纯操作缩。
传感器与预警成标配。
会监护能应急的工人更抢手。

body: 罐车、卡车与船舶装载工将液体气体散料安全装入罐车与船舱，操作装载臂与泵，核对单据计量，监控压力液位并严守安全规范，是危化装卸的一线守门人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate a proposal and calculate every metric in ten minutes, but planners must still decide whether a parcel should become a market or a pocket park and consider how residents will respond.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 44,700 urban and regional planners were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 46,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,500 jobs, with approximately 3,400 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $83,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will replace a large amount of technical work. Automated GIS mapping, proposal generation, metric calculation, and data visualization are advancing rapidly. The planner's core value is shifting toward spatial governance: interpreting policy, coordinating interests, balancing development, and listening to the public. AI can support work that requires judgment and values, but it cannot make the decisions.
ai_s2_accel: Automated interpretation of remote sensing imagery
AI consolidation and analysis of public comments
ai_s2_auto: Automated GIS mapping and spatial analysis
Automated calculation of population and transportation metrics
Automated generation of planning documents and reports
ai_s3_list: Policy interpretation: translate planning regulations and local priorities into spatial language.
Stakeholder coordination: people balance the interests of governments, developers, and residents.
Spatial judgment: look beyond data and develop an instinct for how a place should grow.
Public communication: explain technical plans to residents and incorporate their feedback.
Accountability for proposals: planning mistakes can last for decades, so people must sign off and accept responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 rating means AI has a major role in planners' technical work. Mapping, calculations, and proposal generation are already highly automated. The industry's advantage from drawing plans is disappearing, and value is clearly shifting toward judgment and coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean unemployment; it means changing roles. When AI completes drafting work, planners can focus on higher-value tasks such as policy research, spatial governance, stakeholder coordination, and public participation. Planners who use AI for analysis and accept responsibility for proposals are far more valuable than those who only draw maps.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study urban and rural planning, urban planning, or a related field. Build strong GIS, data analysis, and drafting software skills while reading policy and conducting field research. Planning is a long-term profession with firm educational and registration barriers, so if a bachelor's degree is insufficient, prepare early for graduate study.

Use AI mapping and data analysis tools and reserve your time for policy research and proposal decisions. Earn the Registered Urban and Rural Planner credential and advance toward project leader or principal planner instead of remaining in drafting roles.

People with GIS, architecture, or geography backgrounds can transition relatively smoothly. Enter through planning assistant or data analysis roles while earning credentials, and highlight experience independently completing research and analysis and participating in review presentations.

As AI mapping becomes widespread, hiring should emphasize spatial judgment, policy interpretation, communication, and coordination. Shift roles toward spatial governance and planning consulting, and use credential allowances to retain key professionals.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Rapid AI generation of initial drafts
AI consolidation and organization of comments

ai_s7_trends: Demand for territorial spatial planning and urban renewal continues as the planning industry shifts from expansion to management of existing urban areas.
As AI mapping and calculations become widespread, planners' value is shifting from drawing maps to spatial governance and policy research.
As sustainable development and public participation deepen, planning decisions increasingly depend on data and multi-stakeholder consultation.

body: Urban and regional planners use population, economic, land, and transportation data to develop spatial development strategies for cities and regions. They coordinate land use, public facilities, transportation, ecology, and other elements and support implementation of the plans.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate a proposal and calculate every metric in ten minutes, but planners must still decide whether a parcel should become a market or a pocket park and consider how residents will respond.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能十分钟生成一版方案、算出所有指标，但「这块地留给菜市场还是口袋公园，居民会怎么想」——这个取舍，得由规划师来扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年城市与区域规划师在岗约 4.47 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.62 万人，净增约 0.15 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.34 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.37 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 会替代大量技术性工作：GIS 自动制图、方案生成、指标测算、数据可视化，都在快速自动化。规划师的核心价值转向「空间治理」——解读政策、协调利益、平衡发展和倾听公众意见，这些需要判断和立场的活，AI 只能当工具，不能当决策者。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助用地适宜性评价
多情景方案模拟与推演
公众意见 AI 归并与分析
ai_s2_auto: GIS 自动制图与空间分析
人口交通指标自动测算
规划文本与报告自动生成
ai_s3_list: 政策解读：规划法规和地方意图，要转化成空间语言。
多方协调：政府、开发商、居民的利益，靠人平衡。
空间判断：数据之外，对「这个地方该怎么长」有直觉。
公众沟通：把专业方案讲给居民听，让意见落地。
方案责任：规划失误影响几十年，敢签字、敢负责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明规划师的技术工作 AI 参与度很高：制图、测算、方案生成这些环节已被大量自动化，行业的「画图红利」在消失，价值明显向判断与协调倾斜。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于失业，而是「换岗」——AI 把画图匠的活做完，规划师才有精力做真正值钱的事：政策研究、空间治理、利益协调和公众参与。会用 AI 做分析、敢对方案负责的规划师，比只会画图的值钱得多。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选城乡规划、城市规划专业，把 GIS、数据分析和制图软件学扎实，同时多读政策、多跑调研。规划是「长线职业」，学历和注册证书是硬门槛，本科不够的话尽早规划考研。
把 AI 制图和数据分析用起来，把时间留给政策研究和方案决策。考取注册城乡规划师，往项目负责人、主任规划师方向走，别停留在画图岗。
有 GIS、建筑、地理背景的转行较顺。从规划助理、数据分析岗切入，边做边考证书；面试突出「独立完成过调研分析、参与过评审汇报」的经历。
AI 制图普及后，招人重点看空间判断、政策解读和沟通协调能力。建议把岗位向「空间治理与规划咨询」转型，用注册证书津贴留住骨干。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 意见 AI 归并整理

ai_s7_trends: 国土空间规划与城市更新需求持续，规划行业从增量扩展转向存量治理。
AI 制图与测算普及，规划师价值从「画图」转向「空间治理与政策研究」。
可持续发展与公众参与深化，规划决策越来越依赖数据与多方协商。

body: 城市与区域规划师基于人口、经济、土地与交通数据，制定城市与区域的空间发展战略，统筹用地布局、公共设施、交通与生态等要素，并推动规划落地实施。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate the right replenishment quantity, but buyers still have to trust their instincts when betting on whether an item will take off next year.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 522,200 wholesale and retail buyers, except farm products, were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 552,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 30,100 jobs, with roughly 52,200 openings annually. The median annual wage was about $75,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace buyers, but it will speed up replenishment. Once sales forecasting, product recommendations, and inventory algorithms are handed over to AI, buyers shift from calculating quantities to selecting products, negotiating with suppliers, and betting on trends. What is truly scarce is someone with a feel for the market who can pick the right winners.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted trend analysis and new-product discovery
Slow-moving inventory alerts and clearance recommendations
ai_s3_list: Trend judgment: what will take off.
Supplier negotiation: prices and payment terms.
Assortment strategy: how to combine categories.
Market instinct: combining data with intuition.
Inventory accountability: owning the consequences of a bad bet.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 means this occupation sits in a moderately high-exposure area of commerce data: forecasting, replenishment, and monitoring can all be accelerated, but product selection and negotiation remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: AI replaces the calculating and replenishing, not the selecting and negotiating. Buyers with strong market instincts who can pick winning products will become scarcer. The vulnerable role is the data clerk who only handles replenishment.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in commerce and marketing, and practice data analysis and market research while in school. In the AI era, product-selection instincts matter; do not limit yourself to replenishment work.
Master forecasting and inventory systems, then strengthen your trend judgment. Move from controlling quantities to managing categories and advance into purchasing management.
Highlight the categories you have managed and the breakout products you have picked. A track record in product selection and supplier management comes first.
Hire for market instinct and negotiation skills, not just data ability. Buyers who consistently pick the right products are worth premium pay.

ai_s7_trends: E-commerce livestreaming is reshaping product-selection logic.
Forecasting and replenishment algorithms are becoming widespread, reducing demand for data-only roles.
Hybrid buyers who understand both product selection and data are becoming scarcer.

body: Wholesale and retail buyers select merchandise, develop and negotiate with suppliers, make purchasing decisions, and manage inventory and margins for distribution businesses. They determine which products a channel carries and in what quantities.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate the right replenishment quantity, but buyers still have to trust their instincts when betting on whether an item will take off next year.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把补货量算到刚好，但「明年这个款会不会火」，还得买手凭手感押。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年批发与零售采购员、农场产品在岗约 52.22 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 55.23 万人，净增约 3.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 5.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.57 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代采购员，但会加速补货。销售预测、选品推荐和库存算法交给 AI 后，采购员从「算量」挪向「做选品、谈供应商、押趋势」。真正稀缺的是对市场有手感、能押对款的人。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助趋势与新品挖掘
毛利与定价的智能测算
ai_s2_auto: 库存与周转的自动监控
供应商绩效的自动评分
ai_s3_list: 趋势判断：什么会火。
供应商谈判：价与账期。
组合策略：品类怎么搭。
市场手感：数据和直觉结合。
库存担当：押错要背锅。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的流通数据区——预测、补货、监控都能被加速，但选品和谈判仍留给人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「算和补」，不是「选和谈」。对市场有手感、能押对款的买手更稀缺。怕的是只做补货的数据员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 商贸市场打底，在校多练数据和市调。AI 时代拼选品手感，别只当补货员。
把预测和库存系统用熟，补趋势判断。从「控量」升级成「管品类」，转采购经理。
突出你管过什么品类、押过什么爆款。有选品和供应商成果优先。
招人看市场手感和谈判，不止看数据。能押对款的买手值得高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 电商直播重构选品逻辑。
预测补货算法普及，数据员压缩。
会选品懂数据的复合买手更稀缺。

body: 批发与零售采购员在流通企业负责商品选品、供应商开发与谈判、采购决策以及库存与毛利管理，决定渠道上架商品的种类与数量。
